about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hswa1974 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Subsection (1) in the tree has a paragraph (a) on railway safety and ONR purposes and the word "otherwise" that are not in the source XML, which is the N.I. extent version (URI ends /ni/) while the tree is marked E+W+S.
findings.evidence: source: "and for the purposes of this subsection it is immaterial whether the Executive is or is not responsible" / tree: "(a) those general purposes shall be treated as not including the railway safety purposes or the ONR's purposes; but (b) it is otherwise immaterial"

findings.problem: Subsection (1) is one unbroken sentence in the source but the tree splits its end into paragraphs (a) and (b).
findings.evidence: source: "for the purposes of this subsection it is immaterial whether" / tree: "for the purposes of this subsection" then "(a) those general purposes" and "(b) it is otherwise immaterial"

findings.problem: In (1B), (2)(b)(iii) and (5)(b) the repealed name and the name that replaced it are both kept and run together with no space.
findings.evidence: source: "<Repeal ...>Office of Rail Regulation</Repeal> ... <Addition ...>Office of Rail and Road</Addition>" / tree: "Office of Rail RegulationOffice of Rail and Road"

findings.problem: The source numbers this repealed provision as sections 31 and 32 together, but the tree gives the number as 31 only.

Subsection (2)(a) in the tree has different wording from the source: it names a different body and a different Act (the source given is the N.I. version of the section, the tree text reads like another version).
findings.evidence: source: "in respect of activity undertaken by the Executive in reliance on section 117 of the Railways Act 1993 (safety of railways, &c.), or" / tree: "in respect of activities undertaken by the Office of Rail and Road under or by virtue of this Act or Schedule 3 to the Railways Act 2005; or"

settled.reason: The packet showed the N.I. version of s.43A (two elements share the id; semcheck took the last). The tree holds the E+W+S text, which is right. semcheck now picks the version by the tree's extent.
settled.by: lead agent, checked against the XML
